svg.text: Current implementation • Convex persistence • CS 452 review draft
Every row carries ownerId → authenticated identity (external Better Auth account).
Ownership is one identity to many rows; repeated ownership lines are omitted for clarity.
Hierarchy uses depth + position, not parentId.
Logical reference within the same owner. Trash or unresolved
journal IDs are allowed; this is not an enforced foreign key.
One sync scope per owner + collection
A state row can be absent before a change;
the protocol treats its revision as zero.
Immutable serialized tree nodes; shared by hash.
Each commit has at most one parent;
a parent may have many child commits.
Drafts build checkpoints across bounded transactions; parent/root use the same references as commits.
History currently snapshots todos. Tree data stores historical values and child hashes, not foreign keys to live todo rows.
? Optional field 0..1 Zero or one 0..* Zero or many Dashed line Application-level relationship
Logical keys describe application identity and lookup indexes; Convex does not declare SQL-style unique constraints or foreign keys.
All tables also have Convex _id and _creationTime fields (omitted). Client IndexedDB caches/outboxes and unrelated Garage tables are outside this ERD.
SOURCE packages/os-db/convex/schema.ts · history/schema.ts · osSync.ts · osJournal.ts · history/commits.ts
